subject: Sunrise demo handback — calendar cutover and travel conflict
messages:
From: Michael Santos <michael.santos@aureliahealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: scheduling@aureliahealth.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 01:12:00 +0000
Subject: Sunrise demo — proposed 06:00 UTC (exec sunrise travel)

Hi Soojin / Vanessa,

Thanks again for accommodating Aurelia — we'd like to book the product walkthrough next week. Our exec (Emma Park) has a short window on the 24th and asked for an early slot at 06:00 UTC so it catches her before her flight. Can your team do 06:00 UTC on Thu the 24th? That should be 15:00 SGT for us (and a workable early morning for the EU folks).

Attached is a brief itinerary (aurelia-travel-itinerary.pdf) so you can see the travel constraints. Agenda is also attached.

If 06:00 UTC absolutely won't work, please propose two nearby times and we'll try to reshuffle.

Best,
Michael
Director of Partnerships, Aurelia Health
--
Aurelia Health
Office: +44 20 5555 1212

Attachments: aurelia-travel-itinerary.pdf, demo-agenda-outline.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Michael Santos <michael.santos@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 02:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sunrise demo — proposed 06:00 UTC (exec sunrise travel)

Michael — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Quick note: 06:00 UTC will put our EU infrastructure team at 07:00 BST (still fine) but it will be 14:00 in SGT — I think you meant 14:00 SGT, not 15:00? (There's been a recent summertime shift and a few of our customers are getting tripped up by the handover).

Two practical constraints from our side:
- Our senior infra engineer (Jules) is on travel that day and won't be available until 08:00 UTC.
- We run a streaming demo that needs a warm-up window; starting exactly at 06:00 UTC will compress our prep and risks a degraded experience.

Can we propose either:
1) 07:30 UTC on Thu the 24th (08:30 BST / 15:30 SGT) — gives our engineer time to land and warm up the cluster, or
2) 11:00 UTC on Thu (12:00 BST / 19:00 SGT) — a bit later but keeps execs in APAC within normal hours.

I've looped Kar (karthik_iyer) who handles tri-region handoffs to confirm routing and cold-start windows. Vanessa — marking for account continuity if we need an exec-level swap.

If neither works, I can also offer a short pre-recorded walkthrough we can circulate to Emma ahead of the live session.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
--
Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Michael Santos <michael.santos@aureliahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, scheduling@aureliahealth.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 07:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sunrise demo — proposed 06:00 UTC (exec sunrise travel)

Thanks, Soojin — apologies for the time confusion. Our travel planner had the SGT conversion wrong; Emma's window is actually 14:30 SGT. That means 06:30 UTC, which I realize wedges us between your warm-up window and Jules' arrival.

Option clarity:
- 07:30 UTC works better on your side (we can also move Emma's prep call by 45 minutes).
- If you can do 06:30 UTC with a reduced demo (skip the live streaming test), we could take that as a last resort.

We prefer 07:30 UTC if your team can commit to the warm-up. Please confirm and I'll push a calendar update.

Michael
